subject: two group comparison using FIRMA score for exon 1.0 ST array

messages.subject: two group comparison using FIRMA score for exon 1.0 ST array
parts:
Hi Mark, Elizabeth and Aroma team,

I have successfully run aroma on my 150 exon 1.0 st array data and got
firma score. Since firma score is not based on exon intensity
difference between two or more classes (i.e. control vs treated), I am
having difficulty interperting firma score for my study where 8
samples are control and rest are treated. We are interested in finding
splicing events and importantly frequency of splicing in treated
group. I thought of running limma and t-test to compare two groups and
had thousands of splcied events. To me, that is not convincing and I
wonder if you have any suggestion to improve splciing detection
between two groups. That can help us to validate top hits.

Many thanks!
~SA
